requirements.text: The system shall ensure a maximum of 5 books can be borrowed simultaneously, with a temporary increase to 7 based on member history.
The system shall automatically notify members of overdue books via digital notifications within 24 hours of the due date.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The system shall allow librarians to revoke borrowing privileges for members with outstanding overdue books.
The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit purposes.
The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The system shall track book availability and update the status in real-time to ensure accurate information.
The system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The system shall enable librarians to add or remove books with a latency of less than 3 seconds per operation.
The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The library management system shall implement a recycling program for damaged books, ensuring proper disposal.
The library management system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
